edges: Colonel Hargrave proposes marriage to Laura Montreville after realizing he has offended her.
Hargrave harasses Laura Montreville after accompanying her home.
Hargrave urges Laura to marry him before she finds out about his affair.
Captain Montreville realizes that Hargrave has been threatening his daughter.
Hargrave colludes with Lady Pelham to persuade Laura to marry him.
Hargrave kidnaps Laura and takes her to the wilderness of America.
Laura fakes her own death to escape from Hargrave.
Hargrave commits suicide after Laura escapes.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Laura marries Montague De Courcy after returning to her home country.
Laura goes to live with her aunt Lady Pelham after her father's death.
